title.narrative: Energy JP: Accelerating Maldives transition to Renewable Energy

description.narrative: To address these challenges, and at the request of the Minister of Climate Change, Environment and Energy, a team of experts from UNCDF andUNDP’s Energy and Sustainable Finance Hub visited the Maldives to scope out potential financing solutions to address Maldives renewable energyneeds. Key findings highlighted by the mission are:1. Limited renewable energy capacity due to outdated grid infrastructure, lack of energy management systems, and battery energy storagesystems, leading to grid overload and inefficiencies in load management.2. Challenges in attracting private investments due to high public debt, limited foreign exchange reserves, and off-taker risks, hindering thecountrys energy transition goals.3. Shortage of bankable projects, especially on smaller islands, necessitating a shift towards clustering islands to develop larger renewableenergy projects.4. Overreliance on solar energy and the need to diversify renewable energy sources to enhance resilience and adaptability.5. Lack of inter-ministerial and nation-wide coordination on a long-term energy generation plan, hindering progress towards renewableenergy targets.6. Resource and capacity constraints within ministries, hampering the implementation of energy projects and the mobilization ofinternational climate finance.
